_doc: Provider CLI message parity corpus: makewand/health.py find_cli_messages and router/cli.go findCLIMessages must find the same messages on the same lines. Read by tests/test_cli_message_parity.py and router/cli_message_parity_test.go; after a change to the catalog or to health.py, regenerate 'expect' with UPDATE_CLI_PARITY=1 python3 -m pytest tests/test_cli_message_parity.py.
A string field is a string, or a list of strings and [unit, count] pairs to concatenate.

text is read as one merged stream (merged), as stderr beside an empty stdout (stderr: what the router's formatCLIExecutionError reads) and as stdout beside an empty stderr (stdout); stdout and stderr as streams captured apart (apart). prompt is the prompt as sent.

want (Q: a CLI's own quota or rate refusal, N: task content) and prov label the corpus a case came from (the round-2 verifier, earlier Go and Python tests, engine edge cases); they are not expectations.

expect.<provider>.<modes>.<kind> is the normalized line on which health.py finds a message of that kind, for every kind of the provider's catalog entry; <modes> joins the modes with the same findings by ','. A provider or mode that is absent finds nothing.
